name: Sony WH-CH720N-BLACK Noise Canceling Headphones with Quick Charge with an Additional 2 Year Coverage by Amber Protect (2023)
description:
Noise Canceling: Dual Noise Sensor technology and an Integrated Processor V1 take noise canceling to the next level. Now you can fully immerse yourself in music
Ambient Sound: In Ambient Sound mode; the WH-CH720N headphones capture more of the ambient sound around you thanks to the feedforward and feedback mics; so you can enjoy a natural listening experience while staying connected to your environment. | The Sony Headphones Connect app allows you to adjust the ambient sound in 20 levels; or use the Focus on Voice setting to chat without removing your headphones
Quick Charge: With up to 35 hours of battery life; you’ll have enough power to keep listening all day and into the night. And if you need to top up in a hurry; a 3-minute quick charge will give you up to 60 minutes extra play time. Battery life is up to 50 hours with Noise Canceling off
Precise Voice Pickup: Precise Voice Pickup Technology uses beamforming microphones to allow WH-CH720N headphones to pick up voices clearly and accurately for hands-free calls
2 Year Extended Amber Protect Warranty in Addition to the Included Full Manufacturer Warranty. Intended for Residential Use Only
